answer: To enter earning, an identity must rent one measurement berth in a shared orchard of timing posts and publish a twelve-hour wander trace from its own crystal oscillator. Peers reject a trace whose phase-noise envelope collides with a seated identity, because cloned virtual machines share one clock source. The berth is tagged with an umber residual hash bound to that oscillator; a second name therefore needs a second physical clock and a second paid berth, not merely another keyfile.
